Made from a fiberglass or organic mat coated with asphalt and mineral granules, they provide excellent weather resistance and come in a variety of colors and styles. Metal Roofing Metal Roofing Metal roofing is a durable, long-lasting, and energy-efficient roofing option widely used in residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. Made from materials like steel, aluminum, or copper, metal roofs offer excellent weather resistance, fire protection, and low maintenance Clay Tile Clay Tile Clay tiles are durable, eco-friendly, and aesthetically pleasing building materials used for roofing, flooring, and walls. Made from natural clay and fired at high temperatures, they offer strength, weather resistance, and timeless appeal in both traditional and modern designs. Slate Roofing Slate Roofing Slate roofing is a premium roofing material known for its natural beauty, durability, and longevity. Made from fine-grained metamorphic rock, slate tiles provide excellent weather resistance, fireproofing, and minimal maintenance. With a lifespan of over 100 years, slate is an eco-friendly and elegant choice that enhances the aesthetic and value of any building. reviews.text: Chris With Hybrid roofing is nothing short of amazing! We called him an hour after a crazy storm with hurricane force winds hit our house, and he was at our house within 40 min. We had other companies tell us we needed a whole roof replacement and weren’t even local to Rockwall. Chris showed us the damages and was very fair with pricing. Had the repairs done within a week. AMAZING workmanship and very fair and honest! Something that is very hard to find in a roofing company. Any other roofing needs we have we will strictly go through Chris and Hybrid Roofing!
reviews.author: James Duke

reviews.text:
We had a great experience with Chris!
He was able to schedule a visit and check our roof the same day we reached out, which was amazing! 🌟
He showed up on time, was very friendly, and took the time to explain everything clearly after the inspection.

You can tell he genuinely cares about helping people and knows what he’s doing.

Will I recommend them?

YES, 💯 I WILL!

Thank you again, Chris!
reviews.author: Mayla Savell

reviews.text: Chris and his team did a wonderful job! Chris really made the  progress easy and fast, he is very professional and patient. We will be recommending Hybrid Roofing to all our friends! We love our roof!
reviews.author: Paula Botero

reviews.text:
My name is Angela Phillips and I hired Hybrid Roofing to complete a job for my property in Lancaster,Texas. After meeting with Chris, I loved his spirit, professionalism, and energy. This transaction did not involve an insurance company, yet Chris knew all ends of his industry.
We agreed on a day for the project, but inclement weather forced an adjustment. Once rain was out of the forecast, Chris and his team went to work. The gentlemen began in the early morning hours and worked all day. The job was extremely well managed, organized, and handled with precision and care. I am so grateful for an excellent experience my family and I had with Hybrid Roofing. I highly recommend this company for any roofing project.
Angela Phillips Ed.D.
reviews.author: Aim High Academic LLC

reviews.text: Worked with Mr. Fuentes from start to finish with hail damage on my roof. He ensured that everything was taken care of and my family and I now have a beautiful new roof on our home. We are so thankful for him and his team at Hybrid Roofing. We will be sure to use him on our annual roofing inspections and will be customers for life!
reviews.author: Ben T.

reviews.text: Wow, what a blessing beautiful, beautiful work ! Fidel Fuentes is my to go contractor and roofing specialist! The whole team was so professional, and went the extra mile! Fidel is EXCELLENT With communication and also went above and beyond to make sure my family home was even better than before! I will recommend them above any other!
reviews.author: Tina Maria Wilson

reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Hybrid Roofing!  Sarah and Chris are very professional and did not push me into anything that I did not want to commit to. They walked me through every step of the way. They are both very committed to helping their customers and communicate with you every step of the way! Roof was replaced in one day. Gutters were replaced in one day as well. I am overall very impressed with the work that they provide! I would recommend them to anyone who needs their roof repaired!
reviews.author: Valarie Pargas

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with a fantastic roofing contractor - Hybrid Roofing, and I cannot praise them enough for their outstanding service and professionalism.
From start to finish, they demonstrated an unparalleled level of respect, sincerity, and exceptional communication skills that made the entire experience smooth and stress-free.

Anthony Banda, in particular, stood out as a true asset to the team. His dedication, expertise, and courteous demeanor made a remarkable difference throughout the project.
He went above and beyond to ensure that every aspect of the roofing process was handled with utmost care and precision.

One of the most impressive qualities of this contractor was their commitment to delivering exactly what was promised.
They not only met our expectations but exceeded them in every way. The attention to detail displayed by the entire team was remarkable, leaving no stone unturned to ensure a top-notch final result.

What truly set this roofing contractor apart was their availability and responsiveness. Even on weekends, they were readily available to answer any questions or concerns that arose during the project. This level of commitment and dedication to customer satisfaction is truly commendable and made us feel valued as clients.

Additionally, I want to express my gratitude for the exceptional support provided by this roofing contractor when it came to filing the insurance claim and dealing with the adjuster.
They went above and beyond to assist us throughout the process, making it much smoother and less overwhelming.
When it came to dealing with the adjuster, they were an invaluable ally. They liaised with the adjuster on our behalf, providing accurate and detailed information about the roof damage and the necessary repairs. Their thoroughness and attention to detail helped us secure a fair and satisfactory settlement for our claim.

I cannot stress enough how satisfied I am with the overall experience. The team's professionalism, punctuality, and genuine care for their work shone through every step of the way.
Thanks to their expertise and unwavering dedication, we now have a roof that not only looks exceptional but provides us with peace of mind for years to come.

Thank you again to the entire team for a job well done!
reviews.author: Joe Mac

data.summary: The reviews appear largely authentic with specific, credible details and varied writing styles. However, the perfect 5.0 rating on Google with no sampled negative reviews and the relatively low sample size from the local listing (8 out of 119) raise minor concerns about potential review filtering or lack of critical feedback. The BBB A+ rating with no visible complaints is a positive sign. Overall, the evidence strongly suggests genuine customer satisfaction, but the absence of any critical reviews in the sample is a slight anomaly.
fake_signals: All sampled reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
Some reviews are overly effusive with generic praise
Limited review volume on the sampled Google Maps location (8 reviews) despite 119 total
authentic_signals: Specific details: names (Chris, Fidel Fuentes, Anthony Banda), project types (hail damage, storm repair), timelines (within a week, one day)
Varied writing styles and perspectives (homeowners, business owner)
Mention of adjusting for weather delays
